title: IBBench-Light: A Paired Evaluation of Task-Conditioned Responses to External Directives
abstract: arXiv:2609.13725v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An external record may contain a procedure to apply or text to read, depending on the user's request. IBBench-Light tests both uses against the same record. Twelve semantic bases yield 144 matched pairs per model; four quantized instruction models produced 1,152 archived greedy responses. Paired exact-contract accuracy (PECA) requires both members to satisfy their output contracts. Qwen succeeds on 132 execute and 109 process prompts, but only 97 complete pairs, showing what marginal averages omit. We audit literal-target exposure and case normalization, then add 1,722 logged CPU generations to test directive-absent controls, twelve additional semantic bases, within-base wording changes, and generation stopping. In the pinned Phi rerun, changing the end-of-sequence (EOS) set changes exact paired success from 0/144 to 62/144. translated_title: IBBench-Light：针对外部指令的任务条件化响应的配对评估
translated_abstract: 外部记录可能包含需要执行的过程或需要阅读的文本，具体取决于用户的请求。IBBench-Light 针对同一条记录测试这两种用途。十二个语义基础为每个模型生成144个匹配对；四个量化指令模型共产生1,152条存档的贪婪解码响应。配对精确契约准确率（PECA）要求配对中的两个成员均满足各自的输出契约。Qwen在132个执行提示和109个处理提示上成功，但仅有97个完整配对，这揭示了边际平均值所遗漏的问题。我们审查了字面目标暴露和大小写规范化问题，随后增加1,722条记录的CPU生成，以测试无指令对照、另外十二个语义基础、基础内措辞变化以及生成停止条件。在固定配置的Phi重跑实验中，仅改变序列结束符（EOS）集合就使精确配对成功率从0/144变为62/144。一项有界的IHEval比较使用了相同的SmolLM2检查点和输出预算，同时保留其已公布的指令设置。（注：原始摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出IBBench-Light配对评估基准，证明仅看边际平均准确率会掩盖模型对同一外部记录在“执行”与“处理”两类任务上的表现差异，且仅改变EOS设置即可使精确配对成功率从0/144骤升至62/144。
en_tdlr: IBBench-Light introduces a paired evaluation benchmark demonstrating that marginal average accuracy masks model inconsistencies between execute and process tasks on identical records, and that merely changing the EOS set swings exact paired success from 0/144 to 62/144.
